portfolio.title: All-Keyboard-Shortcuts
portfolio.info: A Front-End only webpage that has a list of common keyboard shortcuts for Windows and Mac Operating Systems and Apps. Uses React and TailwindCSS, with some javascript for functionality.
portfolio.caseStudy: This project was a fun way to practice my React and Tailwind skills, while also creating something that I personally wanted to use. I wanted to create a resource that would be helpful for people who are looking for keyboard shortcuts, and I thought it would be a good way to practice my front-end development skills. I used React to build the user interface and TailwindCSS for styling. The JavaScript was used to handle the functionality of switching between Windows and Mac shortcuts. Overall, it was a great project to work on and I'm happy with how it turned out.
